growth.human-evidence.native-verify: TEST leaf bridge requires deterministic verification by the native Verified Capability Loop, Human Benefit Evidence and Grounded Growth Outcomes implementations.
The positive LIVE admission path has not been exercised because no real human evidence exists.
growth.human-evidence.live-only: Synthetic PASS maps to UNKNOWN and changing synthetic labels to LIVE fails native verification.
Human source authentication remains external and exact source trust is preserved as a reference rather than claimed by the module.
growth.human-evidence.scope-bind: Claim, capability, protocol, judgment, source-trust mode and target scope must agree.
Scope is preserved structurally in the bridge receipt and explicitly in Grounded claim text and limitations.
growth.human-evidence.closure-bind: Current closure must cover native cycle, protocol, evaluation, judgment, comparison artifacts, capability ancestry, candidate-surface relation and source-trust digests.
Missing or held closure maps the human decision to UNKNOWN.
growth.human-evidence.synthetic-hold: Focused fixtures prove a native synthetic PASS remains SYNTHETIC_HOLD and cannot produce HUMAN_GROWTH_ONLY even when the capability is available.
growth.human-evidence.grounded-map: The TEST bridge deterministically emits a digest-bound bridge receipt and Grounded Growth outcome.
Only an admitted live Human Benefit judgment may supply PASS or FAIL; every held path maps to UNKNOWN.
growth.human-evidence.authority.none: The bridge performs no writes and grants no execution, install, permission, promotion, CANON, root-mutation or model-training authority.

growth.human-evidence.live-path.verify: The live path is structurally gated but remains operationally NOT_RUN because no voluntary live session or final human judgment occurred.
A future local result is limited to the named steward unless a declared cohort and external cohort-authentication reference are supplied.
